description: tether/output.py defines the serializable report structs (ArtifactStatus, TetherStatus, StatusSummary, StatusReport, RefsReport, CoverageReport) and the build_* functions that translate tether/status.py check results (ArtifactCheck/TetherCheck and the aggregate/artifact state enums) plus Tether model metadata into JSON. Adding a field to ArtifactCheck/TetherCheck, or a new state, must be propagated into the matching output struct and builder or it silently never reaches the JSON and PreToolUse-hook consumers.
